_comment: Review state for every locale Absolutex ships or plans to ship.
Only facts a person supplies are recorded here. A locale's state (planned / draft /
reviewed), its coverage, and whether its review has gone stale are all COMPUTED by
tools/check-translations.py from the files themselves — a recorded percentage is wrong
the moment English gains a string, and a file that can lie about itself is worse than
The rule this enables: a locale does not enter locales_config.xml until it has a named
reviewer here. Until then its translations can sit in the tree, be checked for
well-formedness, and never be offered to a user. 'en' is the source language, not a
reviewer          who vouched for this translation, by name. null means nobody yet.
reviewed_at       ISO date of that review.
reviewed_against  what was reviewed: the commit, and a digest of the English strings
at that moment. The digest is what makes staleness checkable without
git — it changes only when English strings actually change.
notes             free text for whoever reads this next.

en.notes: Source language. Not a translation, so it needs no reviewer to ship.
